narr: Unusually moist airmass associated with a monsoon surge produce widespread thunderstorms. Flash flooding and debris flows occurred as a result, including on very recent burn scars.
ev: Spotter reported 4-6 inches of water running where Fish Springs and Jacobsen Lane meet. Nearby Pine Nut Creek full due to runoff on the Numbers Fire burn scar.
Nevada DOT reported flooding across US 95 east of Hawthorne at mile marker 40 and flooding across US 95 between Mina and 9 miles north of Mina. The road was closed near Mina due to flooding.
lsr: TRAINED WEATHER SPOTTER REPORTED 4 TO 6 INCHES OF RUNNING WATER FLOWING ACROSS WHERE FISH SPRINGS AND JACOBSEN LANE MEET. NEARBY PINE NUT CREEK WAS REPORTED FULL BY EAST FORK FIRE.
